name: Infinite Brainrot: Craft Merge 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Craft Brainrot is a crafting game where you merge hilariously mismatched elements from Italian meme culture to uncover wild, unexpected combos. You’ll mix things like espresso and ballerinas to create absurd fusions like the Ballerina Cappuccina.
